rows.en:
(I'm supposed to go see a movie with Hoshimura
today... Hoshimura sure is late.)

With tons of people all around us, you went
and overreacted to every single scene,
flailing your whole body around...
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Player scolding Yui after the movie.

rows.en: Heyyy, \p~
Safe, just barely!!

Uh, no. It's already been at least
five minutes since our meeting time.

Aw, cut me some slack for that much.
Safe, safe!

Well, we'll still make the showing, so it's fine.
Let's head to the theater, then.
Aye, aye!
I'm really sorry...
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Yui apologizing after the movie.

rows.en:
With tons of people all around us, you went
and overreacted to every single scene,
flailing your whole body around, y'know...
rows.notes: Male. Variant of c14719 with a trailing sa.

rows.en:
Well, I mean, it was a good movie...
I kinda got sucked into its world.
Well, it sure was a fun movie.

Right, right!?
Then let's grab some tea somewhere
and talk all about today's movie!
Like that one scene...

(All things considered, the movie was fun,
so I guess it was a nice change of pace.)

(I'm supposed to go see a movie with Yui
today... Yui sure is late.)

Well, we'll still make the showing, so it's fine.
Let's head to the theater, then.
Well, it sure was a fun movie.

(All things considered, the movie was fun,
so it was a nice change of pace.)

(Whoa, I was reading in the library
for a change of pace, and now look
how late it's gotten.)

Oho! Why, if it isn't
\p over there!

Huh, Hoshimura.
What were you doing in the library?

I got a not-so-funny score on
Yamashiro-sensei's quiz... so I got
special homework, just for me.

So you came to the library to work hard on it,
but you can't solve any of it and you're stuck.

Exactly~
Help me~, \p~

I don't know if I can solve it either,
but I'll help as much as I can.

Thank youuu, \p~!
I love you~!!

Yeah, yeah.
So, about this problem here...
Mm, mm.
rows.notes: Shared male/female. umu umu, as in earlier Yui slices.

rows.en: Doooone!!!
Good for you, Hoshimura.

It's all thanks to you, \p.
Whew, you really saved my bacon.

Glad I could help.
It's getting late, so let's head home.

Let's, let's!
Thanks a bunch for today.
See ya.
(Phew, I'm glad I could help Hoshimura out.)

(Whoa, I was reading in the library
for a change of pace, and now look
how late it's gotten.)

Huh, Yui.
What are you doing in the library?

So you came to the library to work hard on it,
but you can't solve any of it and you're stuck...

I don't know if I can solve it either,
but I'll help as much as I can.
Good for you, Yui.

Glad I could help.
It's getting late, so let's head home.
(Phew, I'm glad I could help Yui out.)

Thank youuu, \p~!
I love you~!!
rows.notes: Female-version twin of c14744 (extra comma in the Japanese).

rows.en:
(Taking a different way home like this
once in a while isn't half bad.)

(Hm? Isn't that Hoshimura?
What's with that gloomy look on her face?)

Heyyy, Hoshimura.
What's got you staring off into the sunset?
rows.notes: Male. tasogare-chatte: lost in wistful thought at dusk.

rows.en:
Oh... it's \p.
Well, it's just...
(It's rare for Hoshimura to hesitate like that.)

Hoshimura...
I don't know if I can be any help, but if
something's bothering you, talk to me.

\p... Thank you.
The truth is......

I was agonizing over how I could get
a dynamite body like Nanase's.
Huh?

Y'see, a chest like that is every maiden's
dream. Maybe milk's the answer after all?
If I drink it every day, then I too...
Well, I think I'll head home now.

Huh! Wha! H-hold on a sec!
You said you'd hear me out!
C'mon, \p~!

(She was brooding with such a serious face,
I thought it was a real problem...)
(Hoshimura really never changes.)

(Taking a different way home like this
once in a while isn't bad at all.)

(Hm? Isn't that Yui?
What's with that gloomy look on her face?)

Heyyy, Yui.
What's got you staring off into the sunset?
(It's rare for Yui to hesitate like that.)

Yui...
I don't know if I can be any help, but if
something's bothering you, talk to me, okay?
Well, I think I'll head home now.
(Yui really never changes.)

uncertain: c14721: girigiri seefu rendered "Safe, just barely!!".
c14763/c14778: tasogare-chatte rendered as "staring off into the sunset" (wistful at dusk).
